scripts.render: npm run render:mp4 && npm run render:portrait && npm run render:poster
scripts.render:mp4: remotion render src/index.ts DemoLandscape out/badook-demo.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 && node ../scripts/encode-site-video.mjs demo.landscape out/badook-demo.mp4
scripts.render:portrait: remotion render src/index.ts DemoPortrait out/badook-demo-portrait.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 && node ../scripts/encode-site-video.mjs demo.portrait out/badook-demo-portrait.mp4
scripts.render:poster: remotion still src/index.ts DemoLandscape out/poster.png --frame=765 --image-format=png && node ../scripts/encode-site-video.mjs demo.poster out/poster.png
scripts.render:tour: npm run vtt && npm run render:tour:mp4 && npm run render:tour:portrait && npm run render:tour:poster
scripts.render:tour:mp4: remotion render src/index.ts TourLandscape out/badook-tour.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --audio-bitrate=192k && node ../scripts/encode-site-video.mjs tour.landscape out/badook-tour.mp4
scripts.render:tour:portrait: remotion render src/index.ts TourPortrait out/badook-tour-portrait.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --audio-bitrate=192k && node ../scripts/encode-site-video.mjs tour.portrait out/badook-tour-portrait.mp4
scripts.render:seating: npm run render:seating:mp4 && npm run render:seating:portrait && npm run render:seating:poster
scripts.render:seating:mp4: remotion render src/index.ts SeatingLandscape out/badook-seating.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --audio-bitrate=192k && node ../scripts/encode-site-video.mjs seating.landscape out/badook-seating.mp4
scripts.render:seating:portrait: remotion render src/index.ts SeatingPortrait out/badook-seating-portrait.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --audio-bitrate=192k && node ../scripts/encode-site-video.mjs seating.portrait out/badook-seating-portrait.mp4
scripts.render:seating:poster: remotion still src/index.ts SeatingLandscape out/seating-poster.png --frame=880 --image-format=png && node ../scripts/encode-site-video.mjs seating.poster out/seating-poster.png
